stable.label: ecosystem-sandbox-restored-main-experience
stable.note: The multi-creature ecosystem sandbox is again the primary GENESIS experience. It is implemented and source-wired, but this restored route has not yet been independently live/device tested. Physical Creature V1 remains preserved as a separate CI-proven causal test slice.

active_experience.current_change: restore old ecosystem sandbox as main route and improve presentation/jaw placement without deleting prior simulation systems
simulation_changes: morphology-aware jaw and tongue node re-anchoring toward front/underside mouth geometry
per-creature local wetness/biome cache derived from existing material/saturation state
presentation_changes: wet creature highlights derived from simulated saturation
cleaner front/underslung mouth presentation and stronger eye direction
approximations: canopy, light shafts, foreground foliage and extra plant leaves are presentation layers, not new physical simulation
biome labels are classifications derived from local material/heat/wetness fields, not separate simulated biome agents
jaw re-anchoring changes existing jaw/tongue nodes but does not replace the older bite/feeding model with the isolated Physical Creature V1 ingestion model
V109/V110 remain coarse grid/transfer approximations and are not CFD

physical_creature_v1.representation: 2D point-mass articulated skeleton with projected distance constraints and lumped joint-torque muscle actuators
physical_creature_v1.note: This lab is retained for causal body/feeding test work but is no longer the primary user-facing GENESIS route.

legacy_snapshot.note: Snapshot of the pre-restoration V100-V110 stack without old_sim_upgrade.js.

active_objective: Keep the restored ecosystem sandbox as the main GENESIS experience and improve it in coherent, testable passes. First verify the restored live route, then deepen one high-impact subsystem at a time instead of replacing the sandbox with isolated demos.
next_gate: Run the restored /genesis-codehood/ route in a functioning browser, inspect runtime errors/performance and visual mouth/world behavior, then choose the next single subsystem upgrade from real observed weaknesses.
